claims.statement: All 186 stuck orders belong to the v18-rule-affected cohort (EXC-0921) with split-reservation flags. No orders outside EXC-0921 are stuck, and no non-v18 orders are affected.
claims.corroboration: Exception audit (m8_r_exceptions, tier-1) confirms 100% of held orders are in EXC-0921 (v18-affected split-reservation scope), and no order outside it is held.
claims.limitation: Observation confirms v18 orders are stuck, but audit limitation notes it cannot separate a rule-change effect from an east-node-lane effect because only rule-affected orders were routed there. Need cohort-level carve-out testing.

claims.statement: Allocation rule set v18 is either defective (producing invalid splits or failing to allocate correctly) OR the problem is specific to how east-node lanes handle these split-reservation orders from v18.
claims.corroboration: v18 deployment at 22:00 preceded stuck-order reports by 8 hours. Exception audit shows v18 orders exclusively in held cohort. Inventory Control confirmed allocation totals reconcile on their side (m8_e01), suggesting the stuck orders do exist in the allocation system but are not reaching carrier pickup.
claims.limitation: Cannot yet determine if the rule is defective (should not have created split-reservation) or if split-reservation is valid but east-node capacity/carrier-handoff is broken. Requires tracing orders from allocation to carrier-system acknowledgment.

capability_gaps.reason: Cannot determine if orders are stuck at allocation-to-carrier handoff (rule defect) or at carrier-pickup confirmation (carrier lag). Need trace of cohort handoff from allocation system to carrier-integration system.

next_action.rationale: Determine whether orders in EXC-0921 have been handed off to the carrier system and are awaiting carrier pickup, or whether they are stuck at allocation/handoff stage. If they reach carrier system but are not picked up, points to carrier_feed_lag or slot-confirmation gap. If they fail to reach carrier system, points to allocation_rule_defect or handoff bug.
next_action.expected_information_gain: Cohort handoff trace will show the stage where EXC-0921 orders are blocked. This will discriminate between allocation-rule-defect (stuck pre-handoff) and carrier-feed-lag (stuck post-handoff).
